========================================================================
  SALTLINE
  a first-person survival mystery on an abandoned North-Sea oil rig
========================================================================

WHAT'S HERE
-----------
  SALTLINE-Windows.exe   - the game for Windows (64-bit). One file. (1.3 GB)
  SALTLINE-Mac.zip       - the game for macOS (Intel + Apple Silicon). (1.0 GB)
  README-HOW-TO-PLAY.txt - this file.

You only need the file for YOUR computer.


DO I NEED TO INSTALL ANYTHING?
------------------------------
No. These are complete, standalone builds. You do NOT need Godot, a launcher,
or an internet connection to play.


-------------------------  WINDOWS  -------------------------
1. Double-click  SALTLINE-Windows.exe.

2. First time only: Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box,
   because the game isn't code-signed. This is normal for indie builds.
   Click  "More info"  ->  "Run anyway".

3. If your antivirus is nervous, that's a false positive from an unsigned new
   file. The .exe is self-contained: no installer, no system changes.


-------------------------  macOS  -------------------------
1. Unzip  SALTLINE-Mac.zip  to get  SALTLINE.app.

2. First time only: the app isn't notarized by Apple, so a plain double-click
   gets refused. Open it this way instead:
       RIGHT-CLICK (or Control-click) SALTLINE.app  ->  Open  ->  Open
   After the first time it opens normally.

3. If macOS insists the app "is damaged", that's the quarantine flag, not
   damage. Open Terminal and run (drag the app onto the window to fill the path):
       xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /path/to/SALTLINE.app

Universal binary: Apple Silicon and Intel.


-------------------------  CONTROLS  -------------------------
  Move .................. W A S D
  Look .................. mouse
  Sprint ................ Shift
  Jump / swim up ........ Space
  Crouch / dive ......... Ctrl (hold)
  Lie prone ............. Z
  Interact .............. E    (hatches, notes, breakers, taking items, harvesting)
  Use held item ......... Left mouse   (cast, swing, strike)
  Hotbar ................ 1 - 6
  Drop selected ......... G
  Context key ........... F    (throws the hook; reads the handbook you're holding;
                                baits the deep rig winch when you're at it)
  Inventory ............. I
  Journal ............... J
  Help .................. H
  Build mode ............ B
  Pause / options ....... Esc  (volume, mouse sensitivity, sound toggles)

  The game auto-saves at dawn and dusk. Three save slots on the start screen —
  pick one to begin, or Continue a saved run.


-------------------------  YOUR FIRST FIVE MINUTES  -------------------------
  You wake in a survival pod at the waterline. Open the hatch (E) and climb out.

  The rig has no power, and that's the first job. The trail is signposted:
  find the CABLE SPOOL in the pump room, take it up the STAIR TOWER to Level 2
  and splice Breaker 4-A, then throw the master breaker.

  Power brings up the floodlights, the interior lights, the stove and the
  fridge. It matters more than it sounds: until then your only light is the red
  emergency beacons, and after dark the deck is not empty.

  Take the FISHERMAN'S HANDBOOK from the wet deck — it's a real object, so you
  can carry it and set it down wherever you're fishing. It tells you what bites,
  when, in what weather, at what depth, and on what bait. It's the difference
  between fishing and guessing.


-------------------------  STAYING ALIVE  -------------------------
  HUNGER   catch fish, cook it on the stove. Raw fish makes you sick.
  THIRST   rain catchers, or bottled water you find.
  WARMTH   get out of the wet, get inside, sleep in a bunk.
  REST     sleep in a bed at dusk or night to skip to dawn.
  OXYGEN   only shown while swimming. Watch it on deep dives.

  Three ways to fish: a rod off any rail, a drop net, or the deep rig winch on
  the crane machinery deck for the things that live 40 m down. Bait the deep rig
  before you drop it — nothing in the dark rises to a bare hook.

  Go underwater. There's a reef down the caisson legs: coral, sponges,
  barnacles, starfish, ten kinds of tropical fish, mussel beds you can harvest
  and boil, and snails that glow in the dark. There is also a hammerhead.


-------------------------  IF IT WON'T START  -------------------------
  - Make sure the download finished completely (it's a 1+ GB file).
  - Windows: 64-bit Windows 10 or newer.
  - Mac: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or newer.
  - The game ships the OpenGL Compatibility renderer deliberately, so it runs on
    a wide range of hardware. If you get a black or grey screen anyway, your GPU
    driver is likely very old — update it.
  - Running slowly? Try a smaller window. The rig is dense.

  Enjoy SALTLINE.
